about_short_description.short_description: BRKZ is a construction-tech company that provides a one-stop solution by selling building materials to contractors and builders.

product.name: BRKZ Online Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software platform that facilitates ordering and purchasing of construction materials from suppliers.

product.name: BRKZ Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that provides access to the BRKZ Online Platform for ordering construction materials.

product.name: Construction Materials Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers of building materials for construction projects.

product.name: Order and Delivery Management Service
product.description: A service that manages the ordering process and delivery logistics of construction materials to buyers.

product.name: Supplier Pricing and Sales Management
product.description: A service enabling suppliers to set competitive prices and manage sales through the BRKZ platform.
